rdfs:label: Nose-poke
dc:description: Nose enters or occupies a defined port/aperture location.

rdfs:label: Fore-limb
dc:description: Either of the front pair of limbs in a quadruped.

rdfs:label: Manus
dc:description: The distal segment of the fore-limb, homologous to the hand.

rdfs:label: Whiskers
dc:description: Long, stiff, specialized hairs on the face used for tactile sensing.

rdfs:label: Hind-limb
dc:description: Either of the rear pair of limbs in a quadruped.

rdfs:label: Pes
dc:description: The distal segment of the hind-limb, homologous to the foot.

rdfs:label: Tail
dc:description: The posterior appendage extending from the base of the spine.

rdfs:label: Cell
dc:description: The smallest basic structural and functional unit of all living organisms, capable of independent existence and self-replication.

rdfs:label: Neuron
dc:description: An electrically excitable cell specialized for the initiation, conduction, and transmission of information throughout the body.

rdfs:label: Aborted-trial
dc:description: A trial outcome in which the trial is terminated early based on conditions set in the task logic.

rdfs:label: Correct-reject
dc:description: A trial outcome in which the lack of response matches the task's expected behavior.
